title: Parking Services
description: NOTICE OF INTENT � SOLE-SOURCE ACQUISITION Notice No.: 75N98027Q00078 The National Institutes of Health (NIH), National Human Genome Research Institute (NHGRI), intends to award a Firm-Fixed-Price Purchase Order to Vend Park for parking services at 6700B Rockledge Drive, Bethesda, Maryland. Description of the Requirement NHGRI requires parking spaces for its Federal employees and contractor personnel assigned to or supporting operations at 6700B Rockledge Drive. The requirement consists of access to 40 unreserved parking spaces and 6 reserved parking spaces for a Base Period and Four (4) Option Periods. The parking spaces must be located within the 6700B Rockledge Drive complex to ensure employees and contractor personnel have convenient, reliable, and secure access to their assigned work location. The location of the parking facility is an essential requirement because personnel must be able to access the building through an appropriate and accessible route while meeting the facility's security and operational requirements. The contractor shall provide parking access cards to authorized personnel to facilitate access to the designated parking spaces throughout the period of performance. Justification for the Proposed Sole-Source Acquisition The Government intends to solicit from a single source pursuant to FAR 6.302-1, Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements. Vend Park is the proposed source because it owns and operates the only parking facility within the 6700B Rockledge Drive complex capable of meeting NHGRI's parking requirements. The Government's requirement is specific to this location due to the need to provide Federal employees and contractor personnel with parking that supports secure, accessible, and reliable access to their assigned work facility. The availability of parking within the complex is essential to the Government's operational needs. Parking facilities located elsewhere in the surrounding area do not provide an equivalent solution because they cannot meet the Government's requirement for parking within the complex and the associated access requirements for personnel reporting to 6700B Rockledge Drive. Requiring employees and contractor personnel to park at alternative facilities would not provide the same level of direct access to the building and would not satisfy the Government's location-specific security and accessibility requirements. Additionally, the requirement for both reserved and unreserved parking spaces, together with controlled access through parking access cards, must be met at the designated facility. Vend Park is the only identified source with the ability to provide the required parking spaces and associated access at this location. Based on the Government's market research, no other responsible source has been identified that can provide the required parking spaces within the 6700B Rockledge Drive complex while meeting the Government's security, accessibility, and operational requirements. Therefore, the Government has determined that Vend Park is the only known source capable of satisfying the agency's minimum needs and that no other available source can meet the requirement. Response Information This notice is not a request for competitive quotations or proposals. However, interested parties that believe they can satisfy the Government's requirements may submit a written capability statement demonstrating their ability to provide all required parking spaces and meet the specified location, security, accessibility, access, and operational requirements. Capability statements must specifically address the interested party's ability to provide 40 unreserved parking spaces and 6 reserved parking spaces within the 6700B Rockledge Drive complex, including the ability to provide the required parking access cards and meet the Government's location-specific requirements. The Government will review and evaluate all timely submitted capability statements to determine whether another responsible source is capable of meeting the Government's minimum requirements and whether a competitive acquisition is appropriate. The Government anticipates making an award approximately five (5) calendar days after the closing date of this notice, unless the Government determines that another responsible source is capable of satisfying the requirement. Capability statements must be submitted electronically to haunp@mail.nih.gov no later than 9:00 a.m. EDT on November 21, 2026. Please reference Notice No. 75N98027Q00078 in the subject line of the submission.

description: Place of Performance: Portsmouth, VA Kittery, ME Bremerton, WA Pearl Harbor, HI Kings Bay, GA Silverdale, WA Groton, CT San Diego, CA Description This presolicitation notice under FAR 5.101 advises that the Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA) intends to issue a solicitation (request for proposals) in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 for a multiple-award contract indefinite-delivery indefinite-quantity (MAC IDIQ) for discrete production, non-discrete production and other production work to support the Navy�s four public shipyards and Trident Refit Facilities in accomplishing repair, maintenance, and modernization of all submarines. The initial solicitation, N00024-25-R-4321 established a MAC IDIQ framework for procuring work during Chief of Naval Operations (CNO) availabilities on SSNs. This baseline capability is now designated as Requirement 1. This upcoming solicitation also addresses new Requirements 2 and 3. Requirement 2 consists of procuring work during availabilities on SSBNs and SSGNs at designated Submarine Maintenance Repair Facilities. Participating locations include: Norfolk Naval Shipyard (NNSY), Puget Sound Naval Shipyard (PSNS), Pearl Harbor Naval Shipyard (PHNSY), Portsmouth Naval Shipyard (PNSY), Trident Refit Facilities (TRFs) at Kings Bay and Bangor (TRFKB and TRFB), Naval Submarine Base New London (SUBASE New London) and Naval Base Point Loma (NBPL) Requirement 3 consists of procuring work during availabilities on SSNs specifically at TRFKB, TRFB, SUBASE New London, and NBPL. The specific requirements will be defined at the delivery order level, and will encompass efforts such as preservation, structural/non-destructive testing, shipboard work, electrical services, component repair, and engineering support. Efforts include performing drydock submarine repair, maintenance and alterations at NNSY, PSNS & IMF, PHNSY & IMF, PNSY, TRFKB, TRFB, SUBASE New London, and NBPL and performing the repair and restoration of select critical components. Offerors are not required to have their own drydock. Work would be performed under delivery orders anticipated to be competed among MAC IDIQ awardees over a five-year base ordering period with three additional option years, that was already established under N00024-25 R-4321. The awarded contracts included a five-year base ordering period, with three, one-year option periods, for a total ordering period of up to eight years. The ordering period commenced from the time of contract award in FY25 and will run through 1 September 2033, if all options are exercised. The contract periods were established as follows: Base Period - Contract Award through 1 September 2030 Option Year 1 - 2 September 2030 through 1 September 2031 Option Year 2 - 2 September 2031 through 1 September 2032 Option Year 3 - 2 September 2032 through 1 September 2033 Any new award made because of rolling admissions will follow the same contract ordering period periodicity as provided above. The Navy will include rolling admissions provisions enabling the Navy to annually announce an interim competition for the purposes of adding additional contractors to the MAC IDIQ. The Navy has categorized the requirements to be procured under the MAC IDIQ into two tiers: Critical (Lot 1) and Non-Critical (Lot 2), as defined as follows: Critical (Lot 1) requirements consist of efforts that involve critical systems. Due to the nature of critical systems onboard the submarine and the likelihood that delays in completing work associated with these systems will have a significant impact on the overall CNO availability schedule, the Navy will require contractors to possess capability and capacity to meet technical requirements for critical systems to be eligible for Lot 1 scope. To complete this work, awardees are expected to have the knowledge, skills, and experience necessary to complete multiple concurrent complex CNO availabilities on critical systems. Lot 2 scope is expected to require fewer specialized contractor capabilities, both in terms of personnel and equipment. The Navy intends to issue Non-Critical (Lot 2) efforts under a Small Business Set-Aside. title: Denmark – Surveillance and security systems and devices – Overfaldsalarmsystem samt tilhørende udstyr til det sociale område i Region Syddanmark
description: Udbuddet vedrører kontrakt om et Overfaldsalarmsystem samt tilhørende udstyr til Regionens personale og borgere inklusive installation, drift og vedligeholdelse af Udstyr og programmel. Overfaldsalarmsystem skal anvendes til ca. 1.750 medarbejdere med ca. 500 samtidige brugere/medarbejdere fordelt på 20 lokationer (detaljeret information omkring lokationerne følger af udbudsbetingelserne). Kunden ønsker med den kommende Kontrakt at indkøbe en fremtidssikret, sammenhængende Overfaldsalarmsystem, der skal bidrage til at øge personalesikkerheden. Kundens hensigt med anskaffelsen er at optimere og modernisere det borgernære omsorgsarbejde på centrene samt sikre et trygt arbejdsmiljø for personalet. Kunden ønsker en løsning, der kan advisere personalet om både aktivt- og passivt udløste alarmer og nødkald ifm. indtrufne hændelser, eksempelvis når en medarbejder eller en borger aktiverer alarmer og nødkald. Løsningen forventes også at kunne advisere personalet om potentielt forestående hændelser som eksempelvis atypisk og potentielt uhensigtsmæssig adfærd hos borgere. Overfaldsalarmsystem omfatter: • Personalesikring med overfaldsalarm og kollegahjælp for personale på centrene. • Beboer nød- og servicekald på centrene. • Positionering på rum- og zoneniveau. • Sikring af centrene med automatisk genererede alarmer, når beboer passerer bygningsafsnit, yderdøre og matrikelafgrænsning. • App-løsning til smartphone og tablet (iOS/Android) til modtagelse af alarmer. • Vedligeholdelse og fejlafhjælpning af Udstyr og administrationssystem. Det efterspurgte Overfaldsalarmsystem omfatter således alt nødvendigt og relevant udstyr og infrastrukturelementer samt aktiviteter forbundet med implementering, opsætning og vedligeholdelse af Udstyr. Overfaldsalarmsystemet omfatter endvidere Kundens adgang til selvstændigt at administrere og konfigurere løsningen via et passende administrationsmodul. Tilbudsgiver skal tilbyde installation på følgende yderligere lokationer som optioner: • Bihuset Døgn • Bihuset Aflastning • Nymarksvej • Røjleskov • Egely • Lunden Kunden har besluttet ikke at opdele kontrakten i delkontrakter, da der er et vist funktionelt overlap mellem kontraktens omfattede ydelser. Kunden har derfor vurderet det mest hensigtsmæssigt, at den samlede løsning leveres i samme kontrakt, da dette vil give mulighed for at foretage samlet administration af løsningen, hvilket understøtter effektive arbejdsgange hos Kunden. Se forventet tidsplan for projektet i tidsplanen i udbudsmaterialet.

title: UAS AND TRACR II INTERFACE CONTROL DOCUMENT (ICD) COMPLIANCE
description: PURPOSE: Product Manager Tactical Training System (PdM TTS) is requesting information from interested offerors regarding Group 1 UAS compliance with the TRACR II ICD BACKGROUND: PdM TTS is responsible for supporting ranges that utilize the TRACR II software. An emerging requirement includes integration of Group 1 UAS training into these existing ranges. This RFI is intended to gauge industry interest and understanding of the ICD to ensure a common communications interface is established. Please note that the Government team is currently developing a software compliance test tool to validate conformity. This will be released to respondents at a later date. REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (Technical): PDM TTS is seeking proposals from vendors outlining their plan and methodology to demonstrate that their drone solution can successfully integrate with and operate according to the specifications within the UAS TRACR II ICD. The proposal should clearly describe the approach for implementing and validating the required interfaces and behaviors. Respondents should describe their proposed validation strategy, including but not limited to: � Implementation Plan: A high-level plan for implementing the UAS TRACR II ICD communication protocols on existing UAS platforms. � Testing and Validation Methodology: A comprehensive description of the testing procedures, simulation environments, and/or physical tests that would be used to verify full compliance with the ICD. This should cover all applicable messages and behaviors. � Verification of Message Handling: The approach to demonstrate correct parsing, processing, and generation of all relevant messages defined in the ICD, including command and control messages, and status telemetry. � Behavioral Compliance: The methodology to validate that the UAS exhibits the correct behaviors in response to commands, such as path execution, landing protocols, and handling of acknowledgements and fault conditions. � Network Communication: Ability to communicate over IP-based networks, handling point-to-point and point-to-multipoint messages, and correctly interpreting network endpoint data. � Message Processing: Correct implementation of the message header and processing of various message types, including acknowledgment logic and handling of message sequencing. � Control States: Demonstration of the UAS correctly managing and transitioning between control states (No Control, Pilot Control, Central Control) as defined in the ICD. � Command Execution: The ability to correctly receive, acknowledge, and execute key command messages. � Required Hardware: List all hardware required beyond the UAS needed to communicate with the TRACR II Computer (including radios, ground station, etc.). Additionally, respondents are encouraged to comment on any portions of the ICD that are not clear, and to propose any changes that would make implementation more robust. COMPANY PROFILE: To assist the Government in determining if this can be set aside for small businesses, please provide the following administrative information: � Company Name, CAGE Code, and UEI Number. � Point of Contact (Name, Phone, Email). � Business Size Standard and Socio-Economic Status (e.g., Small Business, 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB) under NAICS Code: 541512 for Computer Systems Design or 541511 for Custom Computer Programming). � A brief summary of your company�s experience implementing similar cross-network data transfer solutions in DoD or highly regulated environments. SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS: The Government is exploring a range of acquisition strategies and plans to utilize the information gained from this White Paper to help further shape the acquisition strategy. Responses should be limited to a five (5) page max white paper, not including cover page, cover letter, table of contents and any other documentation submitted in response to Past Performance. Any proprietary concepts of information should be clearly identified as such. Submitted data and information will not be returned. Any information submitted in response to this RFI Notice is strictly voluntary. This notice is for information and planning purposes. description: Tuomi Logistiikka Oy pyytää Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen toimeksiannosta tarjouksia Yhteisöllisen asumisen, kevyen ja tuetun asumisen palvelujen hankintamenettelyn 2489/2024 ensimmäiseen uudelleen avaukseen. Uudelleen avaus koskee osa-aluetta 3 Yhteisöllinen asuminen, vahvempi tuki, päihteet salliva. Yhteisöllinen asuminen, vahvempi tuki tarkoittaa henkilöstön läsnäoloa vuoden jokaisena päivänä palvelukuvauksessa määritellyllä tavalla. Päihteet sallivassa yksikössä päihteiden käyttöä ei varsinaisesti rajoiteta, mutta sen tuottamia haittoja ehkäistään ja vähennetään. Tarvittaessa yksikön henkilökunnan tulee tukea asiakasta kohti päihteettömyyttä. Hankittava palvelu on kuvattu tarkemmin palvelukuvauksessa. Uudelleen avaus koskee hankintamenettelyn osa-aluetta 3. Yhteisöllinen asuminen, vahvempi tuki, päihteet salliva. Uudelleen avauksen osalta hankinnan arvioitu arvonlisäveroton arvo on noin 2 000 000 euroa vuodessa. Arvio on suuntaa-antava eikä sido tilaajaa. Uudelleen avauksessa valitaan halvimman hinnan perusteella kolme (3) uutta yksikköä tuottamaan palvelua. Tilaajan tarve yksiköille painottuu Tampereen alueelle. Hankintamenettelyn perustamisvaiheessa valitut kaksi (2) yksikköä jatkavat palvelua perustamisvaiheen hankintasopimusten mukaisesti ja niiden osalta vanhat sopimukset jäävät voimaan. Kyseisten perustamisvaiheessa valittujen yksiköiden osalta palveluntuottajat voivat kuitenkin jättää tässä uudelleen avauksessa tarjouksen laskeakseen voimassa olevaa hintaa. Palveluntuottajarekisteri päivitetään uusien tarjousten perusteella. Palveluntuottajat luetellaan rekisterissä uuden vertailun mukaisessa sijajärjestyksessä. Hankintamenettelyn avaamisen ja uusien tarjousten myötä myös aiemmin valitun palveluntuottajan vertailun mukainen sijajärjestys saattaa muuttua uuden vertailun perusteella. Hankintamenettelyn uudelleen avauksen yhteydessä hyväksyttyjen palveluntuottajien sopimuskausi alkaa 1.2.2027. Sopimuskausi on voimassa toistaiseksi. Palveluntuottajien on aloitettava palvelutuotanto viimeistään 1.9.2027. Sopimuksen voi irtisanoa hankintasopimusluonnoksessa ilmoitetuin irtisanomisehdoin. Hankintamenettelyn perustamisvaiheessa valittujen palveluntuottajien osalta vanhat sopimukset jäävät voimaan, eikä sopimuskauden pituuteen tule muutoksia tämän uudelleen avauksen myötä. title: Předběžná tržní konzultace – RTG angiografický přístroj vč. příslušenství pro hybridní vaskulární procedury
description: Zadavatel připravuje zadávací řízení k veřejné zakázce na RTG angiografický přístroj vč. příslušenství pro hybridní vaskulární procedury. Předmětem veřejné zakázky bude dodávka RTG angiografu, operačního systémového stolu, 2 sálových monitorů, automatického vysokotlakého injektoru a ultrazvuku nejvyšší třídy včetně echonavigace a 3 ks sond pro potřeby navigovaných výkonů v reálném čase včetně potřebných licencí. Systém musí umožnit kompatibilitu a integraci s angiografem, která je nezbytná při endovaskulárních a hybridních výkonech (např. implantace fenestrovaných/branchovaných stentgraftů, uzávěry defektů, zavádění katétrů do cílových struktur, implantace Tendyne a dalších chlopňových systémů do srdce vyžadující velmi přesnou navigaci a korelaci RTG a TEE). Součástí dodávky budou také nezbytné stavební úpravy a předinstalační příprava.

Rådgivning i forbindelse med projekteringsledelse, herunder IKT-ledelse. c. Rådgivning i forbindelse med byggeledelse, fagtilsyn og projektopfølgning under udførelsen og aflevering, herunder 1-års eftersyn. d. Arbejdsmiljøkoordinering under projektering og udførelse. e. Bistand i forbindelse med gennemførelse af licitation efter tilbudsloven.
